properties.statement:
MEASURED ON REFLOW2'S OWN GRAPH, 2026-08-17, while deciding how far to widen `disconnected_community`. Recorded because the NUMBER survives and the reasoning that stopped it becoming 176 defects would not.

The design network holds 1133 of 2413 nodes and breaks into 183 components:
  1 main body        940 nodes
  6 islands          5, 3, 3, 2, 2, 2 nodes   -> REPORTED (minus containment-attached ones)
  176 SINGLETONS                              -> REPORTED BY NOBODY

And 167 of those 176 HAVE EDGES IN THE FULL GRAPH. They fall through both detectors by construction: `orphan_node`'s degree-zero rule needs zero edges and they have some, while `disconnected_community` filters to clusters of >=2 and a singleton is never a cluster. Mostly Decisions whose only edge is AUTHORED_BY, plus Actors reachable only by INTERACTS_WITH and Contributors only by authorship — none of which are traceability edges.

⛔ NOT TURNED INTO FINDINGS, AND THE REASON IS THE POINT. A Decision carrying only AUTHORED_BY is a recorded thought that governs nothing YET, which `heal.rs`'s own `repair_is_a_judgement` text already calls "a parked thought that correctly governs nothing yet", and which `req:a-deliberate-state-is-not-a-defect` exists to protect. Reporting 176 of them would have raised the defect count roughly sixfold in one release, and would have been the exact failure the epoch this work belongs to is named for. The temptation was real: the sweep was already being widened that day and these were sitting in the same measurement.

SO IT IS A MEASUREMENT AND AN OPEN QUESTION, not a defect list. What it says is that "attached to the design" has THREE states, and reflow2 currently models two: joined to the thread, joined to nothing, and joined only by edges that are not traceability. The third is populous, ordinary, and invisible.

RELATED AND UNANSWERED: `req:a-cluster-can-be-declared-deliberately-separate` asks for a way to declare separation deliberate so islands can be reported as undeclared rather than as a permanent warning. That answers the same shape one size up — a marker for PARKED would let the 176 be counted and named without being called defects. Whether the singleton count belongs in the `disconnected_community` message (where it now appears as scope) or as its own reported number is not settled.
